{{Otheruses|Graveyard}}
The '''ganjuko graveyard''' was a remote, hidden valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], in the northern [[Ragnook Mountains]], formed by a large [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] that struck more than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

Thousands of [[ganjuko]] creatures were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the strike and the remnant [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], leaving their [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]] strewn about the crater. [[Gart (Human)|Gart]], a semi-demented [[human/Legends|Human]], somehow knew about the valley and started talking about it, and a few started to covet the graveyard's secret location for the promise of wealth that lay in the ganjukos' [[Bone/Legends|beaks]], which commanded high prices among [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] society. However the graveyard was sacred to a [[Bothan cult]] that worshipped the ganjukos.

[[Cladus Glynn]], disguised as Gart, led a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] there, followed by [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of [[Beldonna's League]], and ambushed by the cultists, engaged in a fight, only to be joined by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[agent/Legends|agents]], who were eventually interested in the rare stellar metal in the small meteorite.
